sections.title: Purpose of the site
paragraphs: The purpose of this site is to present the spaces, plans and services of the Welcome coworking space at 204 avenue de Colmar in Strasbourg, and to allow visitors to get in touch or arrange a visit.
No online sales are carried out on this site. Services are subject to contracts and terms communicated separately.

paragraphs: All the elements making up the site (structure, text, illustrations, photographs, logos, trade marks, icons, layouts and code) are the property of BUZZ CAPITAL or its partners and are protected by intellectual property law.
Any reproduction, representation, adaptation or exploitation of these elements, in whole or in part and by any means whatsoever, is prohibited without the prior written consent of BUZZ CAPITAL.

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: The data submitted through the contact form (name, email address, phone number and message) is used solely to respond to your enquiry and, where applicable, to arrange a visit to the space. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and French act no. 78-17 of 6 January 1978 as amended, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data. These rights may be exercised by email to contact@welcome-coworking.com.
You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07 — www.cnil.fr).

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The site uses cookies and local storage strictly necessary for it to work, in particular to remember your display preference (light or dark mode) and your audience measurement choice. These do not require prior consent.
With your consent, Google Analytics is used to measure the audience and help improve the site. No Google advertising purpose is enabled and no advertising profiling is carried out.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: The information published on the site is provided for guidance only and may be changed at any time. BUZZ CAPITAL endeavours to keep it accurate and up to date, but cannot guarantee the complete absence of error or interruption of service.

sections.title: Applicable law
paragraphs: This legal notice is governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, and failing an amicable settlement, the competent courts shall be those of the Strasbourg jurisdiction.

sections.title: 9. Personal data and cookies

sections.title: 10. Applicable law and disputes

sections.title: Data collected
paragraphs: We collect only the data needed to get in touch and to arrange a visit where applicable: surname, first name, email address, phone number and the content of your message.
This data is provided voluntarily through the contact form. No data is collected automatically for advertising profiling purposes.

sections.title: Purposes and legal basis
paragraphs: Your data is used to respond to your enquiries, provide the information you have requested and, where applicable, arrange a visit to the space. The legal basis for processing is your consent, given when you submit the form, together with Welcome Coworking's legitimate interest in managing relations with its prospective and existing clients.

sections.title: Data recipients
paragraphs: Only the managers and staff of Welcome Coworking authorised to handle your enquiry have access to your data. It is not sold, rented or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
The site is hosted by Vercel Inc., which may host the technical data associated with messages. This processor acts under the responsibility of BUZZ CAPITAL and in compliance with GDPR obligations.

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: Data from the contact form is kept for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry, then archived for evidential purposes and for the management of commercial relations for a maximum of three years from the last contact, unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.

cookies.intro: This page tells you which cookies and trackers Welcome Coworking uses on welcome-coworking.com, and how you can manage your preferences.

rows.name: welcome-theme
rows.purpose: Remembers your display choice (light or dark mode) so that your experience stays consistent from one visit to the next.

rows.name: welcome-cookie-consent
rows.duration: Until changed or deleted by the user
rows.purpose: Stores the Google Analytics choice: “accepted” for acceptance or “refused” for refusal.

rows.name: _ga, _ga_*
rows.duration: According to the Google Analytics configuration
rows.purpose: Allow Google Analytics 4 (G-P877RD6HJH) to measure the audience after consent.

sections.title: What is a cookie?
paragraphs: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet or smartphone) when you visit a website. It allows the site to remember useful information to make browsing easier and improve your experience.
The term "cookie" is used here in a general sense to cover all trackers set or read when you browse the site.

sections.title: Strictly necessary cookies
paragraphs: Welcome Coworking uses cookies and local storage strictly necessary for the site to work properly. They do not require prior consent.
They are used in particular to remember your theme choice (light or dark) and your Google Analytics choice.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
paragraphs: With your consent, the site uses Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID G-P877RD6HJH) to measure its audience and help improve it. Without consent, Analytics storage remains denied.
Google advertising purposes remain disabled, including after acceptance. The site currently grants no consent for advertising storage, advertising user data or advertising personalisation.

sections.title: Third-party cookies
paragraphs: The only links to third-party services on the site (Google Maps, the WhatsApp button, social networks) may set their own cookies when you interact with them. Welcome Coworking has no control over these cookies and invites you to consult the respective privacy policies of those services.

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can accept or refuse Google Analytics from the banner. Closing the banner is treated as a refusal. Your choice is stored in your browser and can be removed by deleting the site's data.
To find out more about managing cookies in your browser, see the dedicated help pages for Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari or Microsoft Edge.

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: The consent preference remains stored in your browser until you change it or delete the site's data. The lifetime of Google Analytics cookies depends on the service configuration.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This cookie policy may be updated at any time to reflect changes in our practices or in legal obligations. The date of the last update is shown at the bottom of the page.

gestionCookies.intro: This page explains how to manage, enable or delete the cookies set during your visit to welcome-coworking.com.

sections.title: Your preferences on Welcome Coworking
paragraphs: Welcome Coworking uses strictly necessary cookies and storage without consent. Google Analytics is used to measure the audience and help improve the site only if you accept it.
Your choice is stored in “welcome-cookie-consent” with the value “accepted” or “refused”. No Google advertising purpose is enabled.

sections.title: How to manage cookies in your browser
paragraphs: You can configure your browser at any time to accept, refuse or delete cookies. The procedure varies slightly depending on the software you use. Below are the main steps for the most common browsers.

sections.title: Consequences of refusing cookies
paragraphs: If you refuse Google Analytics or close the banner, Analytics storage remains disabled. This refusal does not prevent the site's essential features from working.
Deleting strictly necessary storage may, however, erase your theme preference or your audience measurement choice.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For any question about cookies and managing your preferences, you can contact us at the following address:

guides.name: Google Chrome
steps: Click the three dots at the top right, then Settings.
Under Privacy and security, choose Cookies and other site data.
Enable or disable cookies according to your preferences.
To delete existing cookies, click See all cookies and site data.

guides.name: Mozilla Firefox
steps: In the Privacy & Security panel, find the Cookies and Site Data section.
Choose the level of blocking you want, or click Manage Data to delete cookies.

guides.name: Safari
steps: In the menu bar, click Safari > Preferences.
Under Cookies and website data, choose whether to prevent or allow tracking.
Click Manage Website Data to delete existing cookies.

guides.name: Microsoft Edge
steps: Click the three dots, then Settings.
Go to Cookies and site permissions.
Manage and delete cookies according to your preferences.

accessibilite.intro: Statement drawn up on 2 August 2026 regarding the welcome-coworking.com website.

sections.title: Commitment
paragraphs: BUZZ CAPITAL, publisher of welcome-coworking.com, is committed to making its site accessible to as many people as possible, including people with disabilities, in the spirit of the French general accessibility improvement framework (RGAA 4.1) and the WCAG 2.1 level AA guidelines.

This is a voluntary undertaking: as a private company with fewer than 250 employees and turnover below €250 million, the site is not legally subject to the accessibility obligation set out in article 47 of French act no. 2005-102 of 11 February 2005.

sections.title: Compliance status
paragraphs: The welcome-coworking.com website is partially compliant with RGAA 4.1. No external accessibility audit has been carried out to date; the assessment is based on internal checks.

sections.title: Measures implemented
paragraphs: The following provisions were built into the design of the site:
list: Semantic content structure (hierarchical headings, navigation landmarks, a single main content area per page).
Text alternatives for images that convey information, and accessible labels for icon-only buttons.
Full keyboard navigation with visible focus indicators.
Form fields linked to explicit labels, and error messages in text form.
Reinforced colour contrast and a light / dark mode chosen by the user.
Responsive interface usable on mobile, tablet and desktop, with zoom up to 200% without loss of information.

sections.title: Known limitations
paragraphs: Some content provided by third-party services may not be fully accessible, in particular the embedded Google Maps map and the Google customer reviews widget. The postal address and directions are also available as text, and contact details remain reachable by phone and email.

sections.title: Feedback and contact
paragraphs: If you have difficulty accessing any content or service on the site, you can contact us to obtain an accessible alternative: by email to contact@welcome-coworking.com, by phone on +33 6 22 80 55 36, or by post to BUZZ CAPITAL — 204 avenue de Colmar, 67100 Strasbourg.
We undertake to reply within a reasonable time and to propose a suitable solution.

sections.title: Avenues of recourse
paragraphs: If a report receives no satisfactory response, you may refer the matter to the French Defender of Rights: online form at formulaire.defenseurdesdroits.fr, or by post (free of charge, no stamp required) to Défenseur des droits — Libre réponse 71120 — 75342 Paris CEDEX 07. A local representative can also be contacted in your département.
